paragraphs.text: Per-project isolation for tools, skills, and plugin packs in DeepSeek Harness
# 工具/技能管理 · Tools & Skills
A DeepSeek Harness bundle that manages **tools and skills per project**.
The profile-wide `disabledTools` / `disabledSkills` lists remain the defaults. Every project can the
n override individual entries — inherit, force on, or force off — without changing the profile or af
fecting other projects.
> 插件不在此管理范围内：DeepSeek Harness 在启动时一次性组合插件树，第三方插件无法按项目卸载。请到「设置 → 插件」管理已安装的插件；需要按项目扩展能力时，把工具/技能注册到项目自身
Seek Harness 在启动时一次性组合插件树，第三方插件无法按项目卸载。请到「设置 → 插件」管理已安装的插件；需要按项目扩展能力时，把工具/技能注册到项目自身的技能目录或 Agent 预设中。
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The `id` must stay unique and addressable: the Settings page persists through `configEditor`, which
refuses to write an entry it cannot address unambiguously.
## Configuration
| Field | Meaning |

| `disabledTools` | Global tool names disabled for every project (the profile default) |
| `disabled

Skills` | Global skill names disabled for every project |
| `projects.<absolute root>.tools.<name>`

| `true` force-enables, `false` force-disables; omit to inherit |
| `projects.<absolute root>.skills
.<name>` | Same override semantics for skills |
A project boundary is the nearest ancestor of the session's working directory that contains a `.git`
marker — the same rule `dsh-skill-filesystem` uses for project skill roots, falling back to the wor
king directory itself.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Overrides are machine-local: they live in the active profile's patch, not in the project repository.
## Settings page
Settings → Plugins → **工具/技能管理** (`Tools & Skills`).
- **Scope selector** — `Profile defaults` or any live/configured project. `Add project…` registers a

n absolute path; `Remove project` deletes its overrides.
- **Tools / Skills tabs** — search, per-row
switches, bulk enable/disable, and (project scope) a tri-state override: inherit, force on, force o

ff.
- **Skills** additionally shows source invocation policy and a project-scope “Keep only this” ac

tion.
- Sessions are re-evaluated on every `working-directory/change`: moving a session into another
checkout immediately switches its tool restriction and skill overlay.
## Enforcement
- **Tools** — the effective project policy becomes a per-agent `tools.restrict({ deny })`; names are

denied as soon as their plugin registers them, so a disabled tool never reaches the model.
- **Skil
ls** — a per-agent provider overlays disabled entries as uninvocable (stable catalog), and a `skill`
-tool guard refuses to load them.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The tests use a fake Cordis context: per-agent tool restrictions, skill overlay/guard, working-direc
tory changes, project overrides, project registration/removal, and route validation.
## Limitations
- Only global tool registrations are listed; agent-scoped tools registered by presets or other plugi

ns are managed by their own composition.
- Skills come from the Harness workspace catalog plus proje

ct roots (`<project>/.dsh/skills`, `<project>/.agents/skills`).
- Profile plugins are composed at st
artup and are intentionally out of scope.
